title: Editor Pack Demo — Selection Info
description: A quick tour of the JSON-loaded Selection Info panel shipped by the demo pack.

steps.hint: Welcome! This tutorial ships INSIDE the cardboard-editor-pack-demo .apg — it registered itself the moment the editor loaded the pack.
The pack contributes a Selection Info panel via manifest.editorPanels[]. Open it from the Docks modal to see a JSON-authored inspector form with bound inputs and a Conditional reveal.
That's the demo. Pack-authored tutorials follow the same pack-chain semantics as panels: last-pack-wins on slug collision, live unregister on pack disable.
